rule.include: createResearchLoader(root, loaderOptions) QUALIFIED and listing exchange NYSE/NASDAQ/NYSE MKT(AMEX) and master instrument_type EQUITY_COMMON (or SEC-bound common) and symbol not a preferred/right/unit/warrant by the Nasdaq fifth-letter or provider suffix convention (_P_, _W, _WS, _U, _R, 4 letters + M/N/O/P/R/U/W)
rule.perYear: listing counted in ISO year y when its qualified weekly series has >= 1 bar in y (series are gap-free by validate())

secReference.definition: distinct CIKs per filing calendar year: 10-K or 10-K405 (all registrants, includes OTC and non-listed; order of magnitude); 8-A12B (incl. /A); 25 and 25-NSE

scope: The qualifiable population is the current provider baseline universe (tickers present in today's security master baseline), not the historical US market population. Listings that disappeared before the provider baseline was built are absent; delisted listings appear only where the provider still carries a frozen series and a SEC-sourced last trading day exists. Coverage against SEC 10-K filers is an order of magnitude (10-K filers include OTC and non-listed registrants). Early-year counts are additionally reduced by identity truncation (validFrom) and by INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY/MISSING_WEEKS/CORPORATE_ACTION holds.
